decisions.reason: It extends the firm's existing trommel-screen expertise and showed early positive feedback, so absorptive capacity is high and withdrawal risk is low.
Mobile flail shredders build directly on the firm's mobile machinery and shredding know-how, and the dedicated page indicates ongoing learning potential.
High-speed grinding is adjacent to existing shredding knowledge but its limited website presence and the earlier withdrawal of the green-waste grinder create moderate learning uncertainty.

Stationary electric fine shredding is farthest from the firm's core mobile and waste-processing knowledge, making it hard to interpret results and improve, so the firm likely exits to redeploy resources.
Single-shaft pre-shredding sits well within the firm's waste-processing and shredding expertise, and its dedicated product page supports learning and improvement.
